finding.text: The Sessions page shots all load with empty data (every stat tile shows "—", 0 sessions, and `layout.json`'s own `errors` list shows a 404 on every width) — so item 3's new caption under "Per 1% of your weekly plan" never actually renders in any shot; it's confirmed from the diff's code, not from a picture of it working. shots/1920.png, shots/3440.png; layout.json `errors`.

At 3440 the Sessions row is both big and nearly empty — `share` 0.911, `ink` 0.13, `big_empty: true` — the measurement tool's own flag. Pre-existing (the diff only adds a caption line to existing tiles), and partly explained by the 0-session test data, but it's what the owner's band question checks for. shots/3440.png; layout.json widths.3440.bands[1].

Two wrap entries at every width (`mode-btn`/`brightness_auto`, `drawer-menu`/`☰` at 1200–3440; `drawer-rail-ai`/`drawer-rail-menu` at 400) are pre-existing app-shell chrome, untouched by this diff — named here only because `layout.json` flags them. layout.json widths.*.wraps.
